name: URL Redirects
description: A sign on the door of a page that moved, so old links keep working.
author: Blysis

settingsCards.title: Redirects
settingsCards.description: Old addresses that should lead somewhere new.

api.description: List the redirects, or add one (admin).

urlRedirects.adm_subtitle: When a page moves, every link to the old address keeps pointing at it. A redirect is the sign on the old door.
urlRedirects.adm_fromHint: A path, without the language: /old-pricing, not /en/old-pricing.
urlRedirects.adm_toHint: A path on this site, or a whole https address to leave it.
urlRedirects.adm_permanentHint: On, a search engine forgets the old address. Off is for a move you may undo.
urlRedirects.adm_addFailed: That redirect could not be added.

err.redirect_bad_target: A new address has to be a path on this site or a whole https address.
err.redirect_loop: That would send visitors in a circle.
err.redirect_exists: There is already a sign on that door.

urlRedirects.adm_subtitle: Bir sayfa taşındığında eski adrese giden her bağlantı orayı göstermeye devam eder. Yönlendirme, eski kapıdaki tabeladır.
urlRedirects.adm_toHint: Bu sitede bir yol ya da siteden çıkmak için tam bir https adresi.
urlRedirects.adm_permanentHint: Açıkken arama motoru eski adresi unutur. Geri alabileceğiniz bir taşıma için kapatın.

err.redirect_bad_target: Yeni adres, bu sitede bir yol ya da tam bir https adresi olmalı.
err.redirect_exists: O kapıda zaten bir tabela var.
